integration_issues.issue: Occasionally /api/paynow/banks call from React on cold navigation appears to time out silently (network response never arrives), causing the page to fall back to the plain 'Bank name' text input (data-testid=withdraw-bank-input) instead of the picker trigger. Once the endpoint is 'primed' (e.g. via a manual fetch), subsequent axios calls succeed and the trigger renders. Root cause is likely a slow first PayNow upstream response combined with axios having no timeout — the .catch(()=>{}) silently swallows the failure. Recommend: (a) add a small in-memory cache in server.py for paynow.list_banks() (5-min TTL) so repeat calls are fast, (b) show a spinner while banks are loading instead of the fallback input, and (c) add a lightweight retry in Withdraw.jsx

action_items: Consider caching PayNow bank list on backend (5-min TTL) to eliminate the intermittent slow-first-response that briefly renders the fallback bank-name text input on the Withdraw page.

Optionally render a spinner/skeleton in Withdraw.jsx while `banks` is empty & paynowEnabled is unknown, instead of falling back to the plain text input — this avoids user confusion when PayNow is temporarily slow.
critical_code_review_comments: Withdraw.jsx line 46: `.catch(() => {})` silently swallows /paynow/banks failures. When the request errors, `paynowEnabled` stays false and the user sees a plain 'Bank name' text input with no indication of what went wrong. Should surface at least a toast on failure and/or retry.

server.py user_paynow_banks endpoint hits PayNow on every request — with 32 curated banks and the full 486 fetched each time, this is a hot path called from multiple pages (Withdraw, WithdrawAdmin). Add a small TTL cache.

PayNow's payee query does not return the actual account name — the UI copy is correct about this, but consider fetching + auto-filling the name if PayNow's API ever exposes it, or explicitly disable the account-name input until verify=true to reduce mismatched-name payout reversals.
server.py now 1437 lines — routers split remains overdue.

Backend GET /api/paynow/banks (default) returns 32 curated banks with brand{initials,bg,fg} and total=486. ?all=true returns full 486. rca of the issue: N/A — all iteration-4 features working. The single 'issue' (intermittent /paynow/banks silent failure on cold Withdraw load) is a UX degradation caused by (a) no backend cache for PayNow bank list so upstream latency is felt on every request, (b) axios .catch swallowing errors in Withdraw.jsx line 46, and (c) React StrictMode double-firing the effect and one of the two calls sometimes being aborted. Mitigation: add TTL cache in server.py user_paynow_banks (~5 min) and surface fetch errors as a toast in Withdraw.jsx.
